A note for you

A letter for my princess ♡

Tap the envelope to open your letter

Dear Cutu,

Happy Princess Day to the one who deserves all the kindness, happiness and little moments of magic in the world! Never forget how special you are. Your smile, your silly little ways, and the way you make ordinary conversations feel memorable are all things worth celebrating.

I hope life always gives you reasons to smile, people who appreciate you, and dreams that make you excited to wake up every morning. Keep being your wonderful, goofy, sweet self. You don't need a crown to be a princess — just being you is more than enough. 💗

Thank you for being my favourite person to annoy and my precious best friend. Here's to many more memories, laughs and endless bakwaas together!

Your forever dost ♡
